_comment: App tier (e.g. this repo's Medusa backend / storefronts) - nothing here is open to 0.0.0.0/0. Traffic is only accepted from the web tier's security group, referenced by ID, not by re-deriving the web tier's CIDR/IP range. Replace sg-WEB_TIER_ID with the ID create-sg.sh printed for the web tier.
